title: Eliquis and Lupus Anticoagulant: a hematologist's guide
description: An interactive hematology exhibit exploring apixaban, the coagulation cascade, laboratory interference, and lupus anticoagulant testing with synthetic simulations and cases.

title: VLA Staff Engineer — From Pixels to Reliable Robot Action
description: A 23,000-word, source-linked fieldbook built around the Nidus Staff ML Engineer, VLA Training role. Learn behavior cloning, multimodal and generative policies, robot data engineering, distributed training, evaluation, and on-robot debugging; then prove the skills through seven scoped portfolio builds with explicit simulation and hardware gates. Includes interactive memory, data-mixture, and evaluation-uncertainty labs.

title: AI Engineering Interviews — A Choice, Reason, Trade-off Textbook
description: Interactive interview-prep textbook with 25 original four-part model answers across RAG, agents, and evaluation; includes a RAG pipeline diagram, self-tests, flashcard-style answer reveals, practice timer, and local progress tracking. Question list transcribed from screenshots of a Bashiri Smith post (not independently verified).

title: Finance Interview Textbook — Seven Career Tracks
description: An interactive finance interview textbook covering 70 topics across investment banking, private credit, private equity, hedge funds, sales & trading, equity research, and wealth management. Each section includes an original plain-English explanation, formulas and frameworks, checked worked arithmetic, interview model answers, self-checks, search, and saved progress.

title: AI Agent Harnesses — A Systems Textbook
description: An in-depth, source-linked textbook on AI agent harnesses: three perspectives (control allocation, feedback/observability, state/time) are tested and refined against current papers and major open/proprietary systems. Connects harness design to pretraining, SFT, preference optimization, RL/RLVR, evaluations, security, and systems. Includes interview drills, 48 annotated sources, an interactive reliability lab, and printable textbook.

title: Vision Models & ML Architecture — A Four-Lens Textbook
description: A research-edition textbook on the current state of the art in vision models: why transformers, convolutional networks and state-space models are used, and when each is the wrong choice. Every claim is argued through four named perspectives — inductive bias, optimization, expressivity and systems. Covers the CNN/ViT data-scale crossover, soft and hybrid biases, reverse migration, rank collapse and registers, geometry and packing, self-supervised pre-training (DINOv3, SigLIP 2, Perception Encoder), the four-stage pipeline, RLVR and on-policy distillation, NaViT and variable resolution, FlashAttention and the roofline, mobile silicon, dense prediction (DETR to SAM 3), VLMs, video DiTs, and a four-lens reading of public research from Anthropic and Thinking Machines. Includes 100+ sourced references, a one-page mental model, forty interview questions, a printable TEXTBOOK.md, and an interactive roofline/attention/backbone lab.

title: Applied AI Systems — A Design and Operations Textbook
description: A deeply worked, source-linked AI engineering textbook expanding a 2026 agentic-engineering roadmap: models and inference, workflows, contracts and durable state, retrieval, tools, security, evaluation, operations, voice, eight hypothetical reference architectures, design drills, and an interactive tradeoff and capacity lab. Includes a printable TEXTBOOK.md.

title: Private Markets & Opto — An Operator's Field Guide
description: How private markets actually run: the major players first (pensions, sovereign funds, endowments, insurers, family offices, hedge funds, mega alternative managers, gatekeepers and infrastructure), then asset classes, fund mechanics and metrics with simulators — and a full Opto Investments brief covering its Build/Fundraise/Manage platform, verified-vs-unverified claims, engineering blog (bitemporal data, backfilling, internal Fund Admin tooling), operating leverage, recent developments, and the leadership team. Includes printable TEXTBOOK.md and a one-page brief.

title: Inside Legal AI — Systems Design Field Guide
description: An interactive, evidence-labeled systems-design field guide to Docusign IAM, EveOS, Harvey, CoCounsel Legal, and Legora aOS. Compare feature matrices, trace request flows, inspect rough architectures and data pipelines, and practice interview-ready redesigns with public claims separated from engineering reconstructions.

title: Eliquis, Modern Blood Thinners & Alcohol: Inside Your Brain
description: Plain-English interactive brain cutaway, microscopic vessel patch lab, clotting-cascade family explorer, hangover-vs-bleed unmasker, and 48-hour body simulator explaining why mixing DOACs (Eliquis, Xarelto, Pradaxa) with alcohol cuts both clotting safety brakes inside a rigid skull.

title: Run the Books: Fogline AI — Accounting Flight Simulator
description: Operate a fictional AI startup's books across 16 interactive demos: double-entry, ingestion & dedupe, reconciliation, deferred revenue, invoicing, consolidation, month-end close, safe agent execution, idempotent retries, automation policy, and reading business metrics critically.

title: Inside the Coagulation Lab
description: Interactive 11-bench tour of the listed panel: Vitamin D 25-Hydroxy (LC-MS/MS), Lupus Anticoagulant Reflex (PTT-LA/dRVVT), APS panel (aPTT/PT/INR/TT/hexagonal/aCL+β2GP1), Protein S antigen (total & free), Factor V Leiden PCR, Protein S functional, Antithrombin activity, Protein C antigen, Factor II activity, Protein C functional — plus the synthesis Interpretation Report. Generic educational content only, no personal data.

title: Thin Film Lab: ALD vs PVD
description: Start from zero: why anyone deposits nanometer-thin films (chips, lenses, implants, crisp packets), then three interactive labs on ALD vs PVD — self-limiting reactions, trench conformality, and real growth curves.

title: Nobel Prize Explainer
description: A friendly interactive gallery of the 2023–2025 Nobel Prizes, with approachable exhibits for understanding each breakthrough.

title: Tabby Slink
description: A brown mackerel tabby on a low nocturnal stalk: planted paws, a hovering step, tail-tip freezes, and a coat of broken stripes in moonlight.

title: Interactive Particle Vector Field
description: Real-time canvas flow field with simplex noise, velocity vectors, cursor gravitational attraction, and customizable palettes.

title: Sorting Algorithm Visualizer
description: Step-by-step visualizer comparing Tim Sort, Quicksort, Mergesort, Heapsort, Shell Sort, Radix Sort (LSD), Bubble, and Selection sort with real-time metrics.

title: Cellular Automata Lab
description: Conway's Game of Life, Brian's Brain, and HighLife simulators with interactive brush drawing, preset oscillators, and spaceship launchers.

title: Lower Leg Circulation & DVT Visualizer
description: Explore how leg movement drives the calf-muscle pump and one-way vein valves, compare healthy vs damaged valves, and see why clot healing takes ~3 months.
